verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Gusto generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. Proactive compliance alerts and the 'see where their money stands' view are not described as AI-generated. The Dev Assistant MCP server and the CLI's cash-forecasting skill are developer and agent tooling outside the product UI, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
